class.name: AIBehaviorTrace
class.brief_description: Bounded, opt-in timeline of individual AI task executions within one simulation tick.
class.description: Stores the order that tasks are entered, their tree path, class, returned status and inclusive CPU duration in microseconds. The owner explicitly calls [method begin_tick] to clear old records, [method begin_step] when entering a task and [method end_step] when it finishes. [BehaviorTreeRunner] instruments its entire native Resource tree when [member BehaviorTreeRunner.trace_enabled] is enabled. A trace retains the most recent tick by default. Its per-tick capacity is configurable from 1 to 256 task entries (default 128), with a truncation counter. An independent optional frame-history buffer can retain 1 to 32 of the latest ticks; history is disabled at capacity 0 by default. Disabled runners never construct trace records or call the timing clock. Shared tree Resources do not share trace state, because each runner owns its trace. A custom script task invoked through the native wrapper is recorded as one step, but internal GDScript operations are not instrumented. Values in [method get_snapshot] are detached. The trace exposes task decisions and possibly sensitive names/paths: do not replicate internal AI traces or Blackboard contents to untrusted game clients. This is an execution history and lightweight profiler, not a graphical Godot editor panel, background sampling service, or guarantee that wall-clock execution is independent of frame scheduling.

method.name: set_max_steps
method.description: Sets the number of recorded task entries per tick to 1–256. Changing the capacity clears current state.

method.name: get_max_steps
method.description: Returns the current step limit, initially 128.

method.name: begin_tick
method.description: Starts a new logical AI tick, clearing the previous timeline and incrementing the internal tick index.

method.name: begin_step
method.description: Registers a new task entry in pre-order and returns its token, or -1 if the tick is at capacity. Paths and class names must be nonempty and bounded.

method.name: end_step
method.description: Finalizes the entry with SUCCESS, FAILURE or RUNNING and elapsed microseconds. Returns false for an unknown/already-finished token or invalid status.

method.name: get_snapshot
method.description: Returns a detached Dictionary with tick_index, max_steps, truncated and steps. Every step Dictionary has path, task_class, depth, status and duration_usec. Before its matching end_step, status is -1. CPU duration is inclusive of child execution.

method.name: set_history_capacity
method.description: Configures the replay buffer size (0–32 ticks). Zero disables multi-tick history and releases retained frames. The latest current tick is one of the capacity slots. Invalid limits are rejected.

method.name: get_history_frames
method.description: Returns detached per-tick snapshots oldest to newest, including the latest tick. Each frame has tick_index, max_steps, truncated, steps and a changed Boolean. Changed compares paths, task classes, statuses and truncation with the immediately preceding retained tick; clock jitter and elapsed CPU times alone are ignored. When changes_only is true, unchanged frames are skipped, making it useful for step-by-step AI debugging.

method.name: get_slowest_nodes
method.description: Returns the latest tick's top 0–32 completed nodes by estimated exclusive CPU time, sorted descending with path tie-breaks. Each detached entry includes self_usec and the original duration_usec inclusive span. Exclusive time subtracts immediate executed child spans and is clamped nonnegative; this is diagnostic timing, not a deterministic gameplay metric.

method.name: reset
method.description: Clears the current tick, retained replay frames, truncation counters and tick index without changing step or history limits.

members.member: Maximum number of task entries retained in a single tick.
Maximum replay frames, including current tick. Zero disables replay retention.
